# Legacy save fixtures

These fixtures intentionally retain pre-refactor script or faction resource paths without UID references. Do not rewrite their paths when reorganizing current code.

- `legacy_weapon_match.tres` was generated by `weapon_save_regression` in the unchanged baseline before the folder moves. It covers multiple weapon definitions, typed loadouts, and an embedded custom weapon.
- `legacy_casualty_unit.tres` was generated by `casualty_persistence_regression` in that baseline. It retains a casualty record and equipment state.
- `legacy_soldier.tres` was authored to exercise the former `soldier_save_data.gd` path, identity, weapon state, and combat values.
- `legacy_faction_match.tres` was generated by the unchanged project before the faction folder renames. It references German and US rifle loadouts and a US soldier definition by their old paths, without resource UIDs. `faction_save_compatibility_regression` verifies both faction rosters, weapons, typed resources, and saving/loading the match again.

`save_path_compatibility_regression` loads the original script-path fixtures through the compatibility scripts and checks their values and resource types. `faction_save_compatibility_regression` loads the faction-path fixture through resource redirects. Both regressions save and reload their legacy match.
